# Welcome

Welcome to the Precision Teaching study website. This page includes the required activities for participants assigned to this study condition.

In this condition, you will complete weekly instructional videos with embedded response prompts, use guided notes while watching the videos, attend weekly live coaching sessions, complete frequency-building practice, and complete weekly quizzes.

## Study Timeline

| Week | Required Activities |
|---|---|
| Week 1 | Complete the pretest, Week 1 video, guided notes, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 1 quiz |
| Week 2 | Complete the Week 2 video, guided notes, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 2 quiz |
| Week 3 | Complete the Week 3 video, guided notes, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 3 quiz |
| Week 4 | Complete the Week 4 video, guided notes, coaching session, frequency-building practice, and Week 4 quiz |
| Week 5 | Complete the Week 5 video, guided notes, coaching session, frequency-building practice, posttest, and Week 5 quiz |

## Guided Notes

Please use your guided notes packet while watching each weekly video. The guided notes are designed to help you follow along with the instructional content and complete the embedded response prompts.

If you do not have access to your guided notes packet, contact the research team before beginning the weekly video.

## Coaching Sessions

Please attend your weekly coaching session at your assigned time.

- [Weekly Coaching Zoom Link](#)

During coaching, you will complete frequency-building practice and apply the weekly content to SCC interpretation activities.

## Frequency-Building Practice

Frequency-building practice will occur during coaching sessions. Please bring any materials requested by the research team and be prepared to complete timed practice activities.

## FAQ

### Do I need to complete the guided notes?

Yes. Participants in this condition should complete the guided notes while watching each weekly video.

### Do I need to answer the questions embedded in the videos?

Yes. The videos include required response prompts. Please complete each prompt before continuing.

### Do I need to attend coaching?

Yes. Weekly coaching sessions are part of this condition.

### What should I do if I cannot attend my coaching session?

Contact the research team as soon as possible.

### What should I do if a link does not work?

Contact the research team.
